question: Hydra is an example of which of the following phylum of the animal kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Coelenterata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hydra is an example of the phylum Coelenterata.**
 
• Coelenterates are a group of animals that have** radial symmetry, a gastrovascular cavity, and stinging cells called nematocysts.**
 
• Hydras are small, freshwater animals that have** cylindrical body with tentacles around their mouth.**
 
• **They feed on small animals that they capture with their tentacles.**
 
• **Hydras reproduce both sexually and asexually.**
 
• Hydras have radial symmetry, **which means that they have the same number of parts arranged around a central axis from any point.**
 
• Hydras have a gastrovascular cavity,** which is a single cavity that serves both for digestion and for circulation.**
 
• Hydras have stinging cells called **nematocysts, which they use to capture prey.**
 
• Hydras are small, freshwater animals.
 
• **Hydras reproduce both sexually and asexually.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
 

 Phylum
 Important information
 
 

 Platyhelminthes
 
 
Flatworms, such as planarians, have bilateral symmetry and a flat body.

 
They are mostly hermaphrodites.

 
 
 

 Nematoda
 
 
Roundworms, such as Ascaris, have cylindrical bodies and a complete digestive system.

 
They are mostly parasitic.

 
 
 

 Porifera
 
 
Sponges are sessile animals that have a porous body.

 
They filter food from the water.
